REVENUE SHARE: TRANSFER VS RESPONSE | G3-G6 | E3
|
|-- Build-ahead / Q3 2021: launched
|   |-- [R] Zero revenue share on first $1M earned annually.
|   |-- [S] App model began August; theme model began September.
|   `-- [S] About $11M less Subscription Solutions revenue in Q3.
|
|-- Observed response
|   |-- [S] 2021 app developer earnings +76% to $411M.
|   |-- [S] Developers with an app used by merchants grew nearly 1/3.
|   |-- Revenue-share cut -[D:assoc]-> developer activity.
|   `-- [I] Earnings combine transfers, demand and participation changes.
|
|-- Timing and comparison limits
|   |-- [I] App policy covered ~5 months; earnings growth spans 12.
|   |-- [I] App-count thresholds suggest ~2,000 additions in 2021/2022,
|   |       versus ~2,300 in 2020; not precise comparable increments.
|   `-- [I] Seed's ~9% residual cannot be reconstructed from excerpts.
|
`-- Build-ahead / Q1 2022: continuing accounting effects
    |-- [S] New terms AND gross-to-net theme treatment lowered growth:
    |       ~2 points overall; ~7 points Subscription Solutions.
    `-- [I] These headwinds cannot all be assigned to the share cut.
